description: The PHYSICAL keyword of FUNCTION LENGTH / BYTE-LENGTH (argument-1 PHYSICAL), ISO 15.50.2 / 15.14.2 - introduced 2014 (kb/Work PB4308) with the variable-length group (15.50.4 r8 / 15.14.4 r7): the printed 2002 format is `( argument-1 )`, PHYSICAL is a reserved word only from 2014 (reserved-words.json r85 false / r2002 false / r2014 true), so below 2014 it is a user-defined word and the phrase is no keyword; the 2023 Annex E lists no change to it. The functions themselves are 1985 (LENGTH) and 2002 (BYTE-LENGTH). One row covers both functions, gated in the binder (IntrinsicBinder.BindLengthFamily) like the other function-argument introductions.
display: the PHYSICAL phrase of FUNCTION LENGTH / BYTE-LENGTH
vcr: 2014 introduction (PHYSICAL reserved from 2014; absent from the printed 2002 format; kb/Work PB4308)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.

    COMPUTE N = FUNCTION LENGTH(S PHYSICAL).
    STOP RUN.
